P7631.corridor_notes: 77km branch splits off the 张承支线 (Zhangjiakou–Chengde branch, P7630) at a new Chengde West distribution station and runs to a new Xinglong terminal station in Xinglong County, Chengde.
P7631.researcher_notes: 2 independent sources agree on 77km length. Start-point district (双滦区) is an inferred directional proxy, not confirmed — 承德西分输站's exact county/district was not stated in either source.
